neighbours.label: ' is' after a subject naming a way or means of doing something ('the best way to X is ...'), predicting 'by/through/to'
fire: The quickest way to cool a room is to close the curtains.
One way farmers protect their soil is by planting clover.
The safest method of thawing meat is in the fridge overnight.
A simple way to remember names is to repeat them aloud.
The only way into the castle is through the north gate.
The best way we found to stop the leak is with tape.
Another way to reduce waste is by buying in bulk.
How the virus spreads between cells is through tiny channels.
quiet: The quickest route to the coast is closed for repairs.
The soil on most farms is rich in clay and stones.
The meat in the fridge is ready for the barbecue tonight.
Remembering names is difficult for many people.
The castle on the hill is older than the town itself.
The leak in the roof is getting worse every week.
Buying in bulk is popular with large families.
The virus that spreads between cells is quite rare.
